(Japanese: '''ポケモンバトル:ピカチュウのわくわく大ぼうけん''' ''Pokémon Battle: Pikachu's Big Exciting Adventure'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] created by [[Miho Asada]]. It is one of the manga adaptations of {{aniseries|PTS}}, with one of its chapters based on ''[[AG155|The Green Guardian]]''. It appeared in SHO★1 (小学一年生), starting from April 2005.
